assumptions.message: Default signup role is Reader since public users sign up primarily to read, bookmark, follow sections, and comment.
Added isLeadStory boolean flag on Article to support the requirement that readers see a front page with the lead story.
Articles have an optional leadImage to support visual editorial cards and front page layout.
Comments include readerName string to display commenter identity alongside comments.
Separate areas defined for readers, writers, and editors with custom prefixes and design configurations reflecting their distinct role workflows.
Configured requested style with off-white background (#faf8f5), deep navy accent (#1e3a8a), classic serif headings, and sharp editorial corners per design brief.

Design direction: Bookmark & Read-Later (Minimal & Direct + Demo); palette Paper warm white + ink neutral + minimal accent + tag colors; fonts Minimalist Monochrome Editorial (Playfair Display / Source Serif 4); from ui-ux-pro-max@28b3b8dee8c9

article.submit: only the record's own Writer may do this
article.review: only the Editor assigned to the record may do this

article.releaseScheduled: only the Editor assigned to the record may do this

comment.get: readable by everyone who can read the record it is written on
comment.list: readable by everyone who can read the record it is written on
Follow has no parent record to be made on; placed by default
Follow: title 'section' left out (a enum field is not a name)
look 'minimal' replaced by 'soft': three quiet looks offer no choice
'Published Articles' is computed by article.countWhereStatusPublished (added)
'Drafts Awaiting Review' is computed by article.countWhereStatusSubmitted (added)
'Articles Under Review' is computed by article.countWhereStatusUnderReview (added)
'Scheduled Articles' is computed by article.countWhereStatusScheduled (added)
'Comments Posted' is computed by comment.count (added)
'Articles by Section' is computed by article.countBySection (added)

The look follows the requirement (editorial and trustworthy, a classic serif for headlines, off-white paper and a navy accent): accent #1e3a8a; background #faf8f5; serif headings (Playfair Display); sharp corners
3 seeded record photo(s) from Unsplash, credited where they show
No Unsplash photo for: Article.leadImage 'Grand Dock Theatre Reopens After Meticulous Restoration' (no Unsplash photo for 'Grand Dock Theatre Reopens After Meticulous Restoration Article')
